s01613.summary: Four deadlocked jurors settle in; Beatrice tries to recap while others declare no progress.
Jurors argue whether the signature was genuine or traced and whether the plaintiff lies.
A court officer asks about a verdict; Beatrice buys another hour.
Beatrice writes Evidence on a fresh sheet and the jurors lean in together.

s00227.summary: Jed whittles on a salt flat as Marisol rides in and stops short.
Marisol dismounts without her rifle; they trade terse words about the years since.
Her hand goes to her holster; Jed shows he left his gun in the well.
Marisol draws, shakes, holsters, and slaps him; he takes it and they are even.

s01857.summary: Journalist Nora meets nervous Dr. Elise Marchetti in a dim garage before midnight.
Elise demands her name stay out of the story; Nora resists.
A passing engine freezes them; they learn they have fifteen minutes.
Elise opens the case, revealing backdated drug trial records and eleven patient deaths.
Elise admits she signed the reports and would rather go down with the truth.
Another engine starts; Elise sends Nora off with the case as it closes in.

s01711.summary: Vesta is followed to her car in the garage; a stranger confronts her.
Abel claims he worked with her brother and offers to take her to him.
A sergeant emerges from the dark and orders Abel away from Vesta.
Federal agents arrive and claim Abel is not who he says; he silently says he told her.

s00497.summary: After a failed prom, three teens sit awkwardly by an idling limo.
Blythe says Frankie promised to tell Malik something tonight.
Malik learns Frankie is moving to Denver and told Blythe first.
Frankie has no words; Malik shoves him gently and they stand frozen.
Malik says Denver is not the end; Blythe pins the corsage on Malik.

s01548.summary: Sheriff Jerry makes small talk with Gus on the saloon porch at dusk.
Dolly Mae remarks that watering cattle is no reason to rob a bank.
Veiled widow Prudence rides in and drops a letter on the porch.
She says her banker husband died and someone in town knows how.
Prudence gives them until sunrise and walks into the saloon; they avoid each other's eyes.

s01447.summary: Gwen and Abel trade crossword banter while the doctor watches uneasily.
Samir pulls Gwen aside; Abel watches their whispered, troubled conversation.
Gwen returns with forced cheer; Abel's crossword clue exposes the lie.
Samir shows Abel the downward graph and says he has months.
Abel fills in the crossword with Protect and puts his cap on.

s01342.summary: Crew tend the hydroponic bay, trading small maintenance remarks.
Ship-born Newt wanders in with a bucket of worms and the crew indulge her.

s00260.summary: Five friends camp in the lighthouse while Keziah reads eerie logbook entries.
A creak sounds; Lottie senses something on the stairs and a keeper's figure appears.
The figure descends toward them and Lottie, mesmerized, steps toward it.
The stove dies, the keeper whispers Stay, and Harper wrenches Lottie free as they flee.
Outside, Harper asks Matt to delete the footage and he does.

s01221.summary: Hannelore keeps peeling potatoes while the agent pitches the lighthouse sale.
Hannelore jabs at Ingrid for reading the structural report and leaving.
A recorded coastguard warning plays and Hannelore ignores the handset.
Ingrid urges her to sign; the three argue over the folder and father's burial.
Told her husband wanted her gone, Hannelore hurls a potato and calls Ingrid a liar.
Hannelore touches the radio handset, puts it down, and takes up the pen.

s02415.summary: A bickering family on a road trip fights over kicking, radio volume and the exit.
Mateus swerves for the exit, brakes squeal and a truck honks; they argue whether he missed it.
The baby's giraffe flies into the windshield and she laughs.

s00228.summary: In the hollow-tree archive, keepers record the evening's weather readings.
Bramble-Jack shows a brass key found in a trout and Iluna laughs.
Iluna asks about the legendary door under the tree and Hesperia counsels patience.
Iluna says the river calls the quiet the door, impressing Hesperia.
Bramble-Jack listens, touches the key to wood, and the hidden door opens in gold light.

s02303.summary: Attorney Renata deposes Captain Gwen aboard her boat about a woman found in her hold.
Gwen grimly admits the deckhand went below alive and never came up.

s00826.summary: Neil, Mildred and Fitz explore the derelict rink as a dead organ wheezes.
They see a pair of white skates that were not there before.
The skates slide toward them; Mildred calmly says to note it in the listing.
Fitz reports the doors are locked from outside as the organ plays a chord.

s00396.summary: Aldous, Seren and Pip tease over milk and an invisible cat at tea.
Widow Harrowgate enters, trades barbs with Aldous and takes the head seat.
Everyone falls silent as the lanterns brighten and the kettle sings.

s00226.summary: Auditor Leonidas goes over the ledger as manager Cora brings coffee and watches.
He raises the missing four thousand bushels; she deflects, and he asks for the phone.
They struggle over the phone and the coffee mugs shatter on the ledger.
Leonidas says he already sent copies to the state office; Cora laughs as the belts start.

s02200.summary: Prosecutor Kline starts questioning Nurse Asare about her shift on March ninth.
Kline produces conflicting medication records of fifty and five milligrams.
Asare admits she gave fifty milligrams because the doctor wrote it.
She admits she knew it was wrong when she gave it and why she did it.
Relieved and unsteady, Asare walks out into the light and the judge adjourns.

s01474.summary: Car wash staff trade crossword banter during the quiet 3 a.m. shift.
A black sedan parks outside; Luis warns it has come three nights running.
Mr. Vance steps out, smiling; Luis says he asked about cameras and Nadia grabs something cold.

s00190.summary: The cable car stalls; armed Kazimir stops Tamara filming and eyes Solveig's briefcase.
Kazimir shoots the roof light; Solveig lunges for his pistol and they struggle.
Lucien restarts the brake; Solveig seizes the pistol and Tamara aims at Kazimir.
The case holds only a photograph with Solveig's name; Kazimir wanted the man in it.
Solveig asks who sent him and learns her father took the photo.
At the dock, armed men wear her father's uniforms and her face falls.

s01670.summary: Dez brings Eloise apricot pastries and flirts through the ticket booth slot.
Mrs. Lawson buys tickets, remarks on how alike the two speak, then departs.

s02045.summary: Over dinner on a train, the Countess bluntly disparages the dead man.
Bellwether questions Prisca and catches her in a pen detail.
After a tunnel blackout, he calmly postpones the matter until after dessert.

s02253.summary: Cowhands trade jibes at supper over beans and seconds.
Lazarus and Pete argue which leg of the mare is lame; Hank says to look.
Pete finds a stone in the hoof; the leg quarrel continues until Hank calls everyone to eat.

s00359.summary: Pilot Juno prepares a balloon launch before dawn as Colm glances at Phoebe.
Juno helps Phoebe into the basket while jealous Colm mutters at himself.
Juno coaxes hesitant Colm aboard and the three rise into the first light.

s02306.summary: Five people sit on a farmhouse porch while Isaiah alone watches the road.
A clerk shouts a telegram for Hauser and the porch stiffens.
Eugene has Cora read it; it only asks them to sign for water rights.

s01461.summary: Nana Philomena and young Teodor shape dough animals in the warm kitchen.
Teodor asks for the bread song and they hum it together, slightly off.

s02411.summary: Exhausted parents scramble to warm a bottle while the baby wails at 3 a.m.
The cries finally stop and they whisper, afraid to breathe.
